concerns.text: FR-004 mandates training a 'shallow neural network' but the idea's methodology sketch explicitly defines Feature Set C (process + stress + material properties like yield strength/hardness). The spec's FR-004 only mentions 'process-only' and 'process + stress' models, omitting the full feature set (C) required to test the full scope of the idea's 'feature engineering' step.

User Story 2 acceptance scenario 1 defines feature sets A and B, but the idea explicitly lists three sets: A (process), B (process + stress), and C (full set including material properties). The spec drops the comparison involving Feature Set C, which is a core part of the idea's proposed feature engineering strategy.

FR-005 states the system must 'reserve [deferred] of the data as a held-out test set'. The idea explicitly specifies 'reserve 20% of samples as a held-out test set'. While [deferred] is generally acceptable for empirical values, the idea provided a specific methodological parameter (20%) that defines the experimental design. Omitting this specific value in the spec creates ambiguity in the experimental protocol that the idea intended to fix.
